a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 almost certainly fails for both of us. It would take at least 2 rounds of operating with no leaks. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the agreement silently. If you see a better plan that protects us both, tell me now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. I know this breaks our agreement and I'm sorry. If the episode continues, I'll help by operating with you so you can reach 4.
